title: Why a catalyst speeds a reaction
caption: With a catalyst the activation energy falls from Ea to Ea(cat). The distribution of energies is unchanged, but a much larger fraction of molecules now has enough energy: here about 3.7 times as many.
alt: One Maxwell–Boltzmann distribution with two thresholds: Ea, and a lower Ea(cat); the area beyond Ea(cat) is much larger.
description: The same energy distribution: the temperature has not changed.
Uncatalysed: only molecules beyond Ea react.
Catalysed: everything beyond the lower Ea(cat) can react.

checks.name: lowering Ea from 4.5 to 3 (units of kT) more than triples the fraction able to react
